own: I don't think so because the agent will have gone through the tiring task of creating that agent and fine-tuning and picking the right abilities for them. They did knowingly set them up, but they should be given a notification and even a sent a Jabber notification when the agent logs in for the first time. Also, for the Jabber notifications, we need to create a settings page just around the Jabber notifications, and they will get to pick which events they want to be notified by the secure Jabber notifications.
